config.mcmlxxxiv_jump.title: MCMLXXXIV Jump
config.mcmlxxxiv_jump.enabled.tooltip: Jump automatically before walking off a ledge.
config.mcmlxxxiv_jump.jump_distance.tool: How much travel is left before you would fall when the jump starts. 0 jumps at the last moment on the ground.
config.mcmlxxxiv_jump.jitter.tooltip: Vary the jump distance randomly, once each time you land.
config.mcmlxxxiv_jump.jitter_percent.too: How far the jump distance can vary either way, as a percentage of it.
config.mcmlxxxiv_jump.active_while_sneak: When off, holding sneak stops edge jump.
